title: The Killgrin
summary: A horror movie directed by Joanna Tsanis. From IMDB: "After a personal tragedy, Miranda explores unconventional self-help methods, only to learn from a spiritual healer that she has an infection of her aura called a 'killgrin', which thrives off her misery."
